translations.web: Now the rest of the acts of Uzziah, first and last, Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, wrote.
translations.bsb: As for the rest of the acts of Uzziah, from beginning to end, they are recorded by the prophet Isaiah son of Amoz.
